in_sanskrit.name: एक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Eka is a Sanskrit word that means one. It is a common word used in everyday language and is also used extensively in Hindu scriptures and mythology. In Hinduism, the concept of Ekam (the ultimate reality) is central to various philosophies and religions.

in_hindi.name: एका
in_hindi.long_meaning: Eka is a Hindi word that is derived from the Sanskrit word एक (ek), which means one. In Hindi, Eka is commonly used as a feminine form and can be translated to English as 'one' or 'single'. It is also used in various phrases and expressions, such as 'ek hi' (only one) or 'ek saath' (together).

in_tamil.name: ஐக்கு
